description: Turn a face photo into a lip-synced talking-head video that speaks your text (or your audio). Provide image_url (a clear face photo) and either script (text to speak, max 2500 characters) or audio_url. Optional voice_id / language / voice_settings. Renders in ~1-5 minutes (single call, returns the finished branded video) and is saved to your library. PRICE: Priced per second of the speech (your audio, or the script once spoken; a part second counts as a whole one), charged when the speech is ready and before the video is made, and returned if it fails. Pass seconds with quote_only for a total (suggest_speech_seconds tells you how long a script runs). Pass quote_only: true first to get the exact price; nothing is made and nothing is charged. To run it (not for a quote) send image_url.

audio_url.description: Pre-recorded audio URL to lip-sync instead of generating speech from script.

image_url.description: A clear face photo (Switch/public URL). Required.

quote_only.description: true answers the price only: nothing is made and nothing is charged.

script.description: Text the avatar speaks. Max 2500 characters. Required unless audio_url is given.

seconds.description: quote_only: how many seconds of speech, for a total price.

voice_id.description: Optional voice id (from clone_voice / your library).
